content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides the Isaiah 7:14 link by whether the sign itself states the mechanism rather than by weighing the pressed chains together by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse' — one reading requires comparing the two chains' overall footing; the other permits deciding by whether a single verse/link states the point in its own words.","why":"The quoted words use the retired stating-verse inquiry and do not weigh chain against chain by footing as K-C requires."}
